title: modulePlan
responsibility: Prepare dependency and responsibility-category updates while preserving existing project settings.

inputs.name: modulePackagePlan.root
inputs.description: Project directory: modulePackagePlan reads join(root, 'package.json') without checking the path and never writes it. A missing package.json rejects the call with the read error, and one that is not valid JSON rejects it with a SyntaxError.

inputs.name: modulePackagePlan.definition
inputs.description: Only appOnly, dependencies, devDependencies and packageScripts are read: appOnly is checked against harness.kind and the other three are merged into package.json, while other fields are ignored and the object is not re-validated. A different non-empty existing value under the same name rejects the call instead of being overwritten.

inputs.name: moduleGroupPlan.root
inputs.description: Project directory: moduleGroupPlan reads join(root, 'harness.groups.json') without checking the path and never writes it. A missing file starts from an empty taxonomy, while other read errors and invalid JSON reject the call.

inputs.name: moduleGroupPlan.definition
inputs.description: Only id and title are read: when no group in harness.groups.json has the same id, a group {id, title, terms: [id]} is appended. An existing group with the same id is left unchanged.

outputs.name: modulePackagePlan
outputs.description: Resolves to the PlannedFile for package.json: the parsed manifest with its unrelated fields kept, the module's dependencies and devDependencies merged into their fields, and its packageScripts merged into scripts. The contents are serialized with tab indentation and end with a newline.

outputs.name: moduleGroupPlan
outputs.description: Resolves to the PlannedFile for harness.groups.json: the parsed taxonomy, or an empty schemaVersion 1 taxonomy when the file is missing, with the module's group appended only when its id is not already present. The contents are serialized with tab indentation and end with a newline.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects modulePackagePlan with 'This module requires a Harness app project.' when definition.appOnly is true and package.json's harness.kind is neither 'app' nor 'game'.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects modulePackagePlan when a dependency, devDependency or package script already has a different non-empty value under the same name; the message names the conflicting entry.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects with the readFile error when package.json cannot be read, or when harness.groups.json fails with a code other than ENOENT.

errors.name: SyntaxError
errors.description: Rejects when package.json or an existing harness.groups.json is not valid JSON, because its text is passed straight to JSON.parse.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: Can reject when package.json parses to null or another primitive, because the code then reads or assigns properties on that value.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: Rejects moduleGroupPlan when a parsed harness.groups.json has no groups array, or when a null entry in groups is reached while searching for the module's id.
